name: omarch-eye
author: OmaCheese
description: Look at a window and it gets focus. omarch-eye watches you through a webcam, works out which Hyprland window you are looking at, and focuses it. The eye in the bar turns it on and off; right-click it for calibration, the preview and the camera view. Runs entirely on this computer, and no camera images are saved.

barWidget.description: Turn eye focus on and off; right-click for calibration, the preview and the camera view.
